quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Forge Launches, Turning the AI Loop Production (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave launched CoreWeave Forge, available today, a development layer that runs training, inference, evaluation and agent development in one connected environment, unifying Weights & Biases Models, post-training from OpenPipe and the open-source marimo notebook project with CoreWeave's own services; MasterClass and Canva are already building on it. It ships with CoreWeave ARIA (coding agent, now generally available), CoreWeave Sandboxes (now generally available), the new Agent Lens observability tool, Notebooks, Registry, Post-Training (serverless RL, serverless supervised fine-tuning, distillation) and CoreWeave Inference, whose Dedicated Inference adds RL Rollouts in preview; it comes in Free, Pro and Enterprise editions. Per the release, serverless RL trains 1.4 times faster at 40 percent lower cost than a self-managed setup. EVP Chen Goldberg: Forge brings these capabilities onto one platform 'so what a business learns from running AI becomes part of how engineers improve it'.
quarterly_data.figure: serverless RL 1.4 times faster at 40 percent lower cost than a self-managed setup; Free, Pro and Enterprise editions
